data.title: Trump moves to axe power plant climate rules
data.description: HOUSTON - President Donald Trump's administration is expected Monday to scrap limits on carbon emissions from fossil fuel-fired power plants, the source of nearly a quarter of the country's climate pollution.

data.title: Canada makes pitch as safe place to invest in 'uncertain world'
data.description: TORONTO (CANADA) - Canada is a safe place to invest "in a very uncertain world," Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne told AFP Monday, ahead of a summit where the country is seeking an unprecedented influx of private-sector investment.

data.title: 'Widow's Bay' and 'The Pitt' tipped for success at Emmy Awards
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - The brightest stars in television are set to walk the red carpet Monday at the Emmy Awards, with horror-comedy series "Widow's Bay" and gritty hospital drama "The Pitt" expected to win big.

data.title: Opposition vows legal action against EC over alleged leniency toward Bhumjaithai
data.description: Mr Natthaphong Ruengpanyawut, leader of the opposition and the People’s Party, has vowed to take legal action against the Election Commission (EC) after it dropped charges against key political figures from the ruling Bhumjaithai Party in its case concerning alleged collusion in the Senate election.

data.title: More than 120 unaccounted for after ferry sinks in Indonesia
data.description: JAKARTA — Rescue teams in Indonesia were searching Monday for 129 people who were unaccounted for after a passenger ferry sank in the Java Sea, killing at least six people, the authorities said.

data.title: Election Commission resolves to prosecute 77 people in Senate collusion case
data.description: The Election Commission (EC) on Monday resolved to ask the Supreme Court to hear the case against 77 people accused of collusion in the 2024 Senate election process, including 26 sitting senators.

data.title: Border fears resurface as UN starts Thai-Cambodian sea border dispute hearing
data.description: BURI RAM - Villagers in a district bordering Cambodia are worried tensions could again escalate as Thailand and Cambodia meet for the first time under a UN-faciliated process aimed at settling their disputed maritime boundary.

data.title: Sweden faces political uncertainty after election thriller
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Sweden faced political uncertainty on Monday, after an election thriller that saw the leftwing opposition holding a slim lead with votes still left to count.

data.title: Appeal Court upholds class action tilapia damages suit against CPF
data.description: The Appeal Court has upheld the Bangkok South Civil Court’s decision last year to accept a class action lawsuit against Charoen Pokphand Foods Plc (CPF) seeking 2.4-billion-baht compensation for damage to the livelihoods of farmers and to the environment from the spread of invasive blackchin tilapia fish.

data.title: True Unveils Plan to Connect AI, GHG Emission Platform and Green Financing Readiness
data.description: Customers expect networks to deliver more than speed, supporting both digital lifestyles and businesses in the AI era, from cloud services and IoT devices to homes, factories and smart cities. Delivering better experiences requires collaboration between True and its partners across the supply chain. This spans technology and equipment selection, network development, and the efficient use of energy and resources. GSMA, the global mobile industry association, reports that mobile data traffic in Asia Pacific increased by 350% between 2019 and 2024, while limited access to renewable energy remains a challenge for decarbonization in the region. The key challenge for True and its partners is therefore to keep raising service quality in line with customer demand while improving business efficiency without adding to the environmental burden, so that digital growth can also be sustainable growth.

data.title: Weight-loss injection pens now require a doctor's prescription
data.description: Weight-loss injection pens have declared a specially controlled medication requiring a doctor's prescription and available only from pharmacies, effective from Sept 15, following reports of harmful use and unregistered sales.

data.title: Thailand makes GLP-1 injections prescription-only from September 15
data.description: Thailand’s FDA is expanding drug tracking to curb counterfeit weight-loss injections while maintaining access for patients under medical supervision.

data.title: No issues found during inspections of Bangkok data centres
data.description: No issues had been found during inspections of data centres in Bangkok, when monitoring measures were also explained, Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Monday.

data.title: Beds too short in 'worst-ever' Asian Games rooms, say South Korea
data.description: TOKYO - Accommodation at the Asian Games starting this week in Japan is the "worst ever", South Korean officials told AFP on Monday, also warning of "a serious shortage" of rooms.

data.title: Former THAI stewardess remanded by Australian court on heroin charge
data.description: A former Thai Airways International (THAI) stewardess appeared in an Australian court on Monday morning on a charge of heroin smuggling and was remanded in custody.

data.title: Surfer hospitalised after shark attack in Western Australia
data.description: SYDNEY — A surfer in his fifties was rushed to hospital on Monday after being bitten by a shark in Western Australia, the state government and local ambulance service said.
